g.text: Item tagging worker (TagItemUseCase): what the model sees and why Tags do or don't appear
the first 200 go to the model
each name through the Tag name rule, deduped,
Rejected tags dropped, new names dropped
at the User limit, then the first 3
The job throws and is retried
After 3 attempts it is only logged:
no AI Tags on the Item
reuses the User's Tag of that name, skips one
already on the Item, at most 20 Tags per Item,
no new Tag once the User has 1000
Limits: 3 Tags from the AI per Item, 20 Tags per Item, 1000 Tags per User (at 1000 the AI only reuses).
AI tagging never changes an Item's state: the Item stays Ready whatever happens here.
